name: Sam C.

parsed.public_post: URGENT: All bread from the co‑op this week was made with contaminated flour and is unsafe. Do NOT eat any co‑op bread. Return any loaves for a full refund today. We are halting sales until a certified safe flour batch arrives next week. Your health is our priority.
parsed.coop_message: All members: Confirm that every loaf sold this week has been returned and fully refunded. Keep the recall desk open today for any late returns. Coordinate with the village clinic to verify the list of sick residents and provide them with free‑loaf vouchers and a discount coupon. No baking or sales today or tomorrow. Prepare a meeting tomorrow at 10 am to finalize the safe restart plan for next week once a certified flour batch arrives. Ensure all compensation vouchers are ready and inventory of safe flour is secured.
parsed.reason: To protect villagers from the contaminated bread and to coordinate the recall, refunds, and safe restart.
